The present proceedings are instituted under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking quashing of FIR No.61/2019 registered under Sections 420/468/471 IPC at Police Station Govind Puri, New Delhi on the ground that the parties have amicably settled their disputes.
2. The allegations in the present FIR relate to fraud and forgery committed by the petitioner in the name of investment in certain policies/funds.
3. Mr. Ashneet Singh, learned APP for the State, on instructions, submits that the petitioner is the only accused person and respondent No.2 is the complainant/victim.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the parties have amicably settled their disputes vide Compromise Deed dated 25.05.2023.

Considering the law on the point and the other decisions of this Court on the point, referred to hereinabove, it is observed and held as under:
15.1.

That the power conferred Under Section 482 of the Code to quash the criminal proceedings for the non-compoundable offences Under Section 320 of the Code can be exercised having overwhelmingly and predominantly the civil character,
particularly those arising out of commercial transactions or arising out of matrimonial relationship or family disputes and when the parties have resolved the entire dispute amongst themselves;"
